name: WMA Tract Segmentation with Atlas
summary: Segments a tractogram into tracts by keeping streamlines that connect user-specified pairs of atlas regions, using compiled MATLAB wma_tools, and outputs a white matter classification.
description: Runs the compiled wma_tools function bsc_SegROIfromPairStringList_v2 on the tractogram and a volumetric atlas: for each line of roiPairs it builds two ROIs from the listed atlas indices (optionally inflated) and assigns to a tract the streamlines that connect them; it then generates VTK surfaces of the atlas regions for the viewer. Use it to extract specific connections from a whole-brain tractogram. The registry recommends converting the atlas to ROIs with the ROI Generation App and using WMA Tract Segmentation with ROIs instead. Needs a tractogram and an atlas in the same space.

inputs.description: Volumetric atlas or parcellation (parc.nii.gz with its label key) whose integer indices are referenced in roiPairs.
inputs.requirements: Must be in the same space as the tractogram.

outputs.description: White matter classification (classification.mat) with one tract per ROI pair, plus atlas surfaces for visualisation.

parameters.description: Pairs of ROI sets to segment between: each line is one tract, with the two endpoint sets separated by ';' and each set listing atlas/ROI indices separated by spaces.
Odd whole-number kernel size used to smooth (inflate) each ROI with MATLAB smooth3 before segmentation; values above 1 inflate the ROI and 0 disables inflation.
